title: PRISM/CY — C: Controls
description: Describes what is protecting the enterprise — technical controls (WAF, SIEM, MFA, CSPM, EDR, encryption) and organizational controls (access reviews, training, vendor assessments).

control_function.description: NIST CSF function alignment for this control.

coverage.description: How broadly this control is currently applied.

vendor.description: Tool or service vendor implementing this control.

depends_on.description: IDs of artifacts this control depends on.

as_of.description: Date this dimension file accurately reflected the control posture.

technical_controls.description: Technology-implemented controls: WAF, MFA, SIEM, CSPM, DLP, EDR, encryption.

org_controls.description: Organizationally-implemented controls: access reviews, security training, vendor assessments, policy.

detective_controls.description: Detection-focused controls: SIEM rules, anomaly detection, alerting thresholds.

preventive_controls.description: Prevention-focused controls: WAF rules, IAM boundaries, network segmentation.

corrective_controls.description: Response-focused controls: incident playbooks, auto-remediation, backup and restore.
